---
title: "Quarto Term Demo"
format:
  html: default
  pdf: default
engine: markdown
term:
  shell: "zsh"
  shell_args: ["`--no-rcs`"]
  prompt: "`\\$`"
  theme: solarized-light
  spacing: true
  record: "_session.cast"
  verbose: true
  env:
    PS1: "$ "
---

## Basic Usage

Simple commands in a persistent session:

```{term}
echo 'Hello, world!'
```

Variables persist across cells:

```{term}
export GREETING="Hello from quarto-term"
```

```{term}
echo $GREETING
```

## Working with Files

```{term}
echo "line 1" > /tmp/demo.txt
echo "line 2" >> /tmp/demo.txt
echo "line 3" >> /tmp/demo.txt
cat /tmp/demo.txt
```

## Piping and Arithmetic

```{term}
seq 1 5 | paste -sd+ | bc
```

## ANSI Colors

Commands that produce colored output:

```{term}
printf '\033[31mred\033[0m \033[32mgreen\033[0m \033[34mblue\033[0m\n'
```

## Per-line Options

### Interrupting a long-running command

Send `sleep 100`, then after half a second send Ctrl-C:

```{term}
sleep 100 #! expect_prompt: false
ctrl-c #! literal: false, wait: 0.5, expect_prompt: true
```

### Navigating with arrow keys

```{term}
echo "first command"
up #! literal: false, hold: 0.3
enter #! literal: false
```

## Fullscreen Capture

Capture the entire terminal screen (useful for TUI apps like htop, top, vim):

```{term}
#| fullscreen: true
#| scroll: false
htop #! hold: 2.0, expect_prompt: false
```

```{term}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
q #! literal: false, hold: 0.5
```

## Cleanup

```{term}
rm -f /tmp/demo.txt
```
